subject: Discovery recap + VPC option
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@acme-payments.com>, Greg Shaw <greg@acmepayments.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Discovery recap + VPC option

Hi Lena / Greg -

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum: 

What we heard
- Workload: payment auth + fraud scoring, ~50M requests/month, median request size ~150 tokens
- SLOs: p95 latency target ~200ms for auth flows, some higher-latency batch scoring acceptable
- Data & compliance: PCI scope concerns; want a VPC/on-prem option for production PII-sensitive flows
- Timeline & priority: evaluating vendors now, procurement likely in Q3 if budget approved

Redwood recommendation
- Short term: PoC on Hosted API for product validation and prompt tuning (low friction)
- Mid term: Dedicated capacity or VPC deployment for production to meet PCI & network isolation requirements

Attachments I'm sharing
- acme-scoping-sheet.xlsx (your answers + our recommended capacity profile)
- redwood-vpc-one-pager.pdf (network options, KMS/HSM integration, audit logs)

Proposed next steps
1) Technical deep-dive (30-45m) w/ your infra/ security + our infra lead (Jonas) to walk networking/KMS needs - propose Wed 7/22 or Thu 7/23
2) Mutual action plan: we'll convert the scoping-sheet into an initial implementation estimate and a draft procurement checklist
3) If VPC looks like the right long-term choice we'll prepare a rough committed-cost estimate and timeline for a pilot

Can you confirm whether Wed or Thu next week works for the technical deep-dive, and who from your side should join?

Thanks - happy to adjust based on your procurement cadence.

 - 
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Hi Lena / Greg -

Just bumping this in case it slipped through. Wanted to see if you had a chance to review the scoping sheet and the VPC one-pager I sent. A few quick notes based on internal sizing:
- For your request volume, a dedicated pool with KV cache + prefix caching should cover the latency targets while keeping unit cost predictable
- VPC deployment would let you bring your KMS and meet the audit logging requirements you mentioned

If now isn't the right time for a full VPC discussion, we're happy to start with a hosted PoC and scope migration to VPC when you're ready. Either way, a short technical sync (30m) will help us avoid rework.

Are you still aiming for a Q3 procurement decision? If your timeline shifted, let me know and I'll adjust our recommendations.

If helpful, I can have Jonas join next week to answer network-level questions - any preference for days/times?

Best,
Marissa
